column5: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration Bulk Card Lot ~2 lbs Commons Uncommons + Holos
column11: Bulk lot of English Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration cards, about 2 lbs. Mostly commons and uncommons, plus the holo and foil cards shown in the photos.
